title: Bazooka players, Boise and Peewee, and Hudson
summary: Asked about bazooka horns, Vincent remembers two boys, Boise and Peewee, from when he first came down there, and says he remembers Hudson.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
